import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import normalize, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# --- Configuration and Paths ---
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Load data files
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB)

# Get the column order from sample_submission for consistent output format
col_order_for_submit = list(sample_sub.columns[1:])  # Skip 'id'
n_classes = len(col_order_for_submit)
print(f"Number of classes to predict: {n_classes}")
print(f"Class order for submission: {col_order_for_submit}")


# Text processing pipeline: preprocess text consistently
def preprocess_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        # Convert to lowercase
        text = text.lower()
        # Remove common punctuation and quotes
        import string

        punct_chars = set(string.punctuation) - {"'", '"'}
        cleaned = [c for c in text if c not in punct_chars]
        # Join without punctuation, then collapse whitespace
        cleaned = " ".join(cleaned).strip()
        return cleaned
    return text


text_train_processed = [preprocess_text(t) for t in train_df["text"]]
text_test_processed = [preprocess_text(t) for t in test_df["text"]]

# Encode author labels
le = LabelEncoder()
le.fit(train_df["author"])
class_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(le.classes_)}
idx_to_class = {idx: name for name, idx in class_to_idx.items()}

# Create clean stratified train/val split BEFORE modeling
X_train_raw_np = np.array([preprocess_text(t) for t in train_df["text"]])
y_train_encoded = le.transform(train_df["author"].values)

# Split 80-20 for train/validation - IMPORTANT: validation set NEVER used for fitting
_, X_val_holdout_np, _, y_val_holdout_encoded = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw_np,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

# Train model on FULL training set (validation data excluded)
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw_np)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_holdout_np)

clf = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, C=1.0, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", penalty="l2"
)
clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_encoded)

# Validate ON HOLDOUT VALIDATION SET only (never seen during training)
val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)
val_proba_clipped = np.clip(val_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
y_val_onehot = np.eye(n_classes)[y_val_holdout_encoded]

# Compute multi-class log loss: official metric formula
val_log_loss = -np.mean(np.sum(y_val_onehot * np.log(val_proba_clipped), axis=1))
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Log Loss: {float(val_log_loss):.6f}")

# Predictions on TEST SET (use same vectorizer and model)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(text_test_processed)
test_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)
test_pred_proba_clipped = np.clip(test_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Generate submission file
pred_data = []
for i in range(len(test_df["id"])):
    row_dict = {"id": str(test_df["id"][i])}
    for j, col_name in enumerate(col_order_for_submit):
        prob_value = float(test_pred_proba[i][j])
        row_dict[col_name] = round(prob_value, 6)
    pred_data.append(row_dict)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(pred_data, columns=["id"] + col_order_for_submit)
submission_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)

print(f"Submission file saved to {OUTPUT_FILE}")
print(f"Hold-Out Validation Log Loss: {float(val_log_loss):.6f}")
